verdict.rationale: Unstructured's security overview documents SOC 2 Type 2 audited controls and HIPAA security requirements for PHI. It also offers dedicated-instance or VPC deployment with full data isolation, which covers the compliance half of the story for contracts and medical records. However, nothing in the evidence documents zero-retention handling of uploaded documents; isolation and encryption are related controls, not a retention guarantee. Missing for 10: documented zero-retention or no-storage policy for uploaded files, details on how to enable HIPAA (e.g. BAA availability or plan tier), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, uploaded documents get zero-retention handling with SOC 2 and HIPAA options, so I can process contracts and medical records

citations.quote: SOC 2 Type 2: Controls are implemented and audited for security, availability, and confidentiality.
HIPAA: The system meets the security requirements of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) for safeguarding protected health information (PHI).
Deploy Unstructured in your own dedicated instance or VPC with multi-user access, full data isolation, dedicated technical support, and pricing tailored to your needs.
